reference_sql:
SELECT t.parent_category, t.category_name, t.units
FROM (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT parent_category, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY parent_category, category_name
) AS t
WHERE t.units = (
  SELECT MAX(t2.units)
  FROM (
    -- one row per category
    SELECT parent_category, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
    FROM sales
    GROUP BY parent_category, category_name
  ) AS t2
  WHERE t2.parent_category = t.parent_category
)
alternatives:
WITH category_units AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT parent_category, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY parent_category, category_name
),
parent_top AS (
  -- one row per parent category
  SELECT parent_category, MAX(units) AS top_units
  FROM category_units
  GROUP BY parent_category
)
SELECT c.parent_category, c.category_name, c.units
FROM category_units c
JOIN parent_top t ON t.parent_category = c.parent_category AND t.top_units = c.units

solver.query:
WITH cu AS (SELECT c.parent_category, c.category_name, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.parent_category, c.category_name)
SELECT parent_category, category_name, units FROM cu WHERE units = (SELECT MAX(units) FROM cu x WHERE x.parent_category = cu.parent_category)
